as_told.title: Ingo Swann spied on the ONI remote viewing program for Scientology
as_told.place_text: Office of Naval Intelligence remote viewing program

plain: A lawyer named Dan Sheehan says that in the 1970s Ingo Swann, a well-known psychic, was secretly sending reports to the main Guardian's Office of the Church of Scientology in the UK. According to Sheehan, those reports described the inner workings of a remote viewing program, an effort to use the mind to see distant places, run by the Office of Naval Intelligence, the US Navy's spy service. If true, it would mean a church was quietly watching a secret military psychic project from the inside.
